description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pethiyagoda, Rideemaliyadda D/S Division, Badulla District - Cad. Map No. 710012
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extent measurements, ownership details, and land classifications. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property title determinations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
